title: Alliance Pact
next_chapter_hook: As the crowd deliberated, a savage aura suddenly swept in from outside the hall. Han Lie descended like a god of war, clutching a bloodstained military order in his hand—the Xuanwu Sect would launch a full-scale assault on the Tianqing Sect in three days.

text.content: The Tianji Record's trembling was like thunder exploding within his Mental Sea. The blurred vision was like a dull blade, mercilessly gouging at Chen Ji's heart. His sister Chen Nian's figure flickered in and out within the depths of the Forbidden Grounds, and the one guarding her... Chen Ji clenched his fists so tightly that his fingernails embedded into his palms, blood dripping between his fingers. It was the most unexpected person—the very existence he had once trusted the most. He drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. The Tianji Record would not deceive him, but neither would it reveal all truths. This was not the time for anger, but for scheming. The capital's situation was far more complex than he had imagined, yet since he had come, he would never leave empty-handed.

In the Bamboo Grove of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, morning mist lingered, dewdrops sliding down bamboo leaves and pattering softly onto the ground. Su Qingyao stood in the bamboo pavilion, her pure white gown slightly fluttering in the wind, a faint worry creasing her brow. She had been in seclusion at the Back Mountain when urgently summoned by Chen Ji. When she saw Chen Ji step into the grove, her heart suddenly skipped a beat—she had never seen Chen Ji with such a grave expression. In those eyes that were usually calm as still water, an unfamiliar fire was burning.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji? What happened? Your expression... it's so terrible.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He sat down across from Su Qingyao, his gaze falling upon the curling tea fragrance, as if organizing his chaotic thoughts. After a moment, he raised his head, his voice low yet resolute: "Qingyao, I need you to help me with something." He spoke softly, yet Su Qingyao could hear the weight of a thousand junns in his words. In all the time she had known Chen Ji, she had never heard him speak in such a tone—this was not a request, but a commission.

dialogue.content: I'm going to the capital.
The capital? That's the core of the Great Zhou Dynasty, where three major sect forces are deeply intertwined. You alone...

text.content: Before Su Qingyao could finish, Chen Ji interrupted her. He drew a Jade Slip from his breast and gently set it on the stone table: "I've already confirmed that Chen Nian is in the Forbidden Grounds deep within the capital." The moment the words "Chen Nian" left his mouth, Su Qingyao distinctly felt Chen Ji's aura falter for an instant. She had never heard Chen Ji mention having a sister, but from his reaction, this person named Chen Nian was far more important to him than appearances suggested.

Su Qingyao gazed at the Jade Slip, then looked up at Chen Ji. Morning light filtered through the bamboo leaves, falling upon his face—that face which usually wore a nonchalant smile, now seemed draped in frost. Her heart suddenly tightened—she had never seen Chen Ji show such vulnerability. This man who always had every contingency planned was revealing his most authentic emotions before her.

dialogue.content: I'll go.

text.content: No hesitation, no questions about the reason, not even asking what dangers awaited her in the capital. Su Qingyao's answer was brief and resolute, as if this were not a mission that could cost her life, but merely a trivial matter. Chen Ji was stunned. He raised his head and looked into Su Qingyao's eyes. There was not a trace of hesitation in those pupils, only something that made his heart contract sharply—trust, unreserved trust.

dialogue.content: You're not asking what I'm going to do? Not asking how dangerous it is? You just agreed?

A slight curve lifted at the corner of Su Qingyao's lips, and on that usually cold visage, a trace of gentle smile actually appeared: "You're Chen Ji. You never fight battles without certainty, and you'd never let yourself fall into a certain death situation." She paused, her voice softening a degree, "Moreover... the very fact that you're willing to tell me about this already shows you trust me. Why would I have any reason not to trust you?"

text.content: Chen Ji felt as if something had struck his chest hard. This woman, clearly the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow and the most talented disciple of the Tianqing Sect, was willing to risk her life for a废物 disciple. He opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but found his throat blocked as if by something. After a long while, he spoke quietly: "Qingyao, thank you." These four words were spoken lightly, yet they weighed like a thousand junns.

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's毫不犹豫 commitment, Chen Ji was deeply moved. How should he respond to this sincere friendship?

choices.description: Reveal Chen Nian's identity, the secrets of the Tianji Record, and all the dangers of the capital without hiding anything from her
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's favor and trust increase significantly, unlocking a deeper bond
choices.risk_hint: Exposing trump cards may bring unknown risks

dialogue.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath and made a decision he had never made with anyone—he told Su Qingyao about the existence of the Tianji Record. "Qingyao, there's something I've been hiding from you." His voice was soft, yet carried unprecedented solemnity.
Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply. The Tianji Record? That legendary forbidden artifact? She gazed at the fragment glowing with a dim light in Chen Ji's hand and was momentarily speechless.

Chen Nian is my biological sister. She was taken by the Holy Sect to serve as some kind of 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'. The Tianji Record foresaw her location in the capital's Forbidden Grounds, but the one guarding her... is someone I never expected." Chen Ji's voice turned somewhat hoarse. "I must rescue her, no matter what price I have to pay."

Su Qingyao fell silent for a long while. When she spoke again, her voice carried a slight tremor: "So that's how it is... No wonder you've always concealed your true strength, no wonder you always find a way out in desperate situations." She raised her head, her gaze resolute. "Chen Ji, no matter how arduous the road ahead, I, Su Qingyao, will not retreat a single step."

At that moment, Chen Ji felt the ice in his heart shatter completely. Looking at Su Qingyao, he suddenly smiled—a smile from the depths of his soul, utterly unguarded. "Alright." He only said one word, yet it seemed to contain thousands of unspoken meanings.

Su Qingyao reached out and gently grasped Chen Ji's hand. Their palms pressed together, warmth mingling. The two characters "共命" surfaced in her heart—she didn't know where this phrase came from, yet she instinctively understood its meaning. From now on, their fates would be intertwined as one.
[System Prompt: Bond with Su Qingyao upgraded! Unlocked "Shared Destiny" skill—Su Qingyao can share the Heavenly Fate consumption when using the Tianji Record!]

Su Qingyao suddenly felt a warmth spreading through her chest, as if something within her was awakening. She looked down to see a faint silver pattern emerging on her palm, resonating with the pattern on Chen Ji's hand. "This is..."

Chen Ji stared at the silver pattern, his heart churning with immense waves. He knew what this meant—the Tianji Record was acknowledging Su Qingyao, drawing her into his destiny. "Shared destiny... it actually exists." He murmured to himself, voice filled with disbelief.

Su Qingyao did not ask what this meant. She simply quietly felt the warmth emanating from that pattern, a sense of unprecedented peace rising in her heart. She knew that from this moment on, her fate with Chen Ji had become tightly intertwined, impossible to separate.

choices.description: Only tell her what she needs to know, preserving the core secrets of the Tianji Record and Chen Nian's identity
choices.visible_cost: May miss out on deepening the bond
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the mystery of hidden cards, Su Qingyao still trusts him
choices.risk_hint: May develop a trust crisis in the future

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, ultimately choosing to hold back. He couldn't take the risk, dared not take the risk. The existence of the Tianji Record was too terrifying—once leaked, the consequences would be unimaginable. "Qingyao, there are people I must save in the imperial capital." His voice was calm. "The specifics, I暂时不能告诉你."
Su Qingyao's eyes dimmed slightly for an instant, but quickly returned to calm. She did not probe further, only nodding gently: "Alright."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a pang of guilt in his heart. He knew Su Qingyao agreed to help him without hesitation, yet he couldn't even bring himself to tell her the truth. But there was no alternative—he couldn't protect anyone, except by first protecting himself.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao seemed to sense his internal struggle, and suddenly laughed softly: "Chen Ji, you don't need to feel guilty." She reached out and gently poked his forehead. "Everyone has secrets, I understand. When you're ready, you can tell me."

text.content: Her kindness made Chen Ji feel even more guilty. He silently vowed that after all this was over, he would tell her all the truth. He owed her an explanation.

Just then, soft footsteps sounded outside the Bamboo Grove. Chen Ji and Su Qingyao turned their heads simultaneously to see an elderly figure approaching slowly—it was Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master Ling Yuan. Dressed in a gray Taoist robe, his hair white as snow, his kind face carried an air of authority.

dialogue.content: "Heh, I didn't expect to arrive at just the right moment." Ling Yuan stroked his beard, smiling warmly. "Chen Ji, you came to find Qingyao—what for? Perhaps I can be of assistance."

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly as he scrutinized Ling Yuan. This old man was the pillar of the Tianqing Sect, also an existence he could never fully comprehend. On the surface, Ling Yuan had shown him much favor, but Chen Ji always felt something lay hidden behind this "favor." The Tianji Record fragments had faintly hinted that Ling Yuan had an inexplicable connection with "Chen Xuan."

dialogue.content: "Sect Master." Chen Ji rose and bowed respectfully, neither servile nor arrogant. "This disciple intends to travel to the imperial capital to handle some private matters."

"The imperial capital?" Ling Yuan's brow furrowed slightly. "That place is a dragon's pool and tiger's den, with the three major sects' forces intertwined—you, a Servant Disciple..." His gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a moment, then suddenly shifted direction. "Well then, it's good for young people to have drive. This old man happens to have some intelligence that might be useful to you."

text.content: Alarm bells rang in Chen Ji's heart. Ling Yuan taking the initiative to offer intelligence? This was far too unusual. But on the surface, he remained composed, respectfully asking: "I wonder what guidance the Sect Master has?" Ling Yuan stepped closer, lowering his voice: "In three days, the Xuanwu Sect will launch a full-scale attack on the Tianqing Sect." At these words, both Chen Ji and Su Qingyao's expressions changed.

dialogue.content: "No need for surprise." Ling Yuan's expression was calm. "This is intelligence from my insider within the Xuanwu Sect. That boy Han Lie has already sharpened his knives." He took out a jade slip from his sleeve. "Inside is the Xuanwu Sect's deployment map and a list of insiders. With this, your imperial capital journey might go more smoothly."

text.content: Chen Ji took the jade slip, his divine sense probing inside. He indeed saw dense deployment markers and several deeply hidden names. His brow furrowed even tighter—Ling Yuan's intelligence was terrifyingly precise, which meant the Tianqing Sect's infiltration within the Xuanwu Sect was far deeper than it appeared on the surface. But this also made him more vigilant: why would Ling Yuan help him?

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan proactively provides crucial intelligence. How should Chen Ji view this "kindness"?

choices.description: Accept the intelligence, but secretly probe Ling Yuan's true purpose—his relationship with Chen Xuan
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues about Chen Xuan's legacy
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may detect the probe

dialogue.content: Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip into his chest, bowed respectfully and said, "Thank you for your generous kindness, Sect Master. The disciple is deeply grateful." He paused, then shifted topics, "But this disciple has one question—why does the Sect Master show such favor to me?"
Ling Yuan's gaze flickered slightly, then he smiled: "You remind me of someone."
"Who?" Chen Ji pressed, his heart racing involuntarily.

"An old acquaintance." Ling Yuan's voice suddenly grew distant, "Someone who once earned this old man's admiration, and also made this old man..." He didn't finish, just glanced at Chen Ji meaningfully, "Never mind, let's not revisit the past. Go ahead, and be careful on your journey to the imperial city."

text.content: Chen Ji watched Ling Yuan's departing figure, his heart churning. An old acquaintance? Who could make this old Sect Master admire and yet... resent? Be envious? The Tianji Record's words echoed in his mind: Ling Yuan was the previous generation's candidate for Chen Xuan's legacy, passed over by the Tianji Record and consumed by resentment. Could all of this be true?

choices.description: Politely refuse Ling Yuan's intelligence, expressing that he can accomplish it independently and does not need others' help
choices.visible_reward: Not let Ling Yuan know his whereabouts, maintain independent action
choices.risk_hint: The journey to the imperial city may become even more difficult

dialogue.content: Chen Ji returned the Jade Slip to Ling Yuan, his expression respectful yet resolute: "Thank you for your kindness, Sect Master, but this disciple has always acted independently and dares not trouble the sect."

A subtle, cold glint flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes, though his smile remained warm: "Very well, it's good for young people to have pride. But..." he gave Chen Ji a meaningful look, "the imperial city's situation is more complex than you imagine. If you encounter difficulties, feel free to come find this old man."

text.content: Su Qingyao watched Ling Yuan's departing back, her brow slightly furrowed. She always felt that in that fleeting moment, Ling Yuan's gaze at Chen Ji was off—not the look of an elder observing a junior, but more like... a hunter examining prey. But she didn't ask further, only gently squeezing Chen Ji's hand.

dialogue.content: "You did the right thing." she said quietly, "This Ling Yuan... I always feel he's not simple."

Chen Ji nodded, but in his heart, he was rapidly calculating. Ling Yuan's appearance was by no means coincidental—his intelligence was terrifyingly accurate, which showed that the Tianqing Sect had deep infiltration within the Xuanwu Sect. But the more this was the case, the more he dared not easily accept. What purpose lay hidden behind this "kindness"?

text.content: However, the list of Xuanwu Sect insiders in that Jade Slip gave him some ideas. Even if he didn't accept Ling Yuan's help, the value of this intelligence itself was immeasurable. He could verify its authenticity through other channels.

After Ling Yuan left, silence returned to the Bamboo Grove. Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze falling in the direction of the distant imperial city: "Tonight." Su Qingyao nodded without a word. The two stood there quietly, letting the morning breeze brush across their faces.

A moment later, Chen Ji suddenly let out a light laugh. That laugh carried a bit of emotion, a bit of relief, and even a trace of warmth that was hard to detect. "Qingyao, don't you sometimes feel... this world is strange?" Su Qingyao was slightly stunned: "What do you mean?" Chen Ji turned to look at her, light flickering in his eyes: "It's clearly a chaotic world, clearly people's hearts are unfathomable, yet precisely at this time, I can meet a friend like you."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's heart猛地漏跳了一拍。 She looked into Chen Ji's eyes—those eyes that no longer held their usual coldness and scheming, only a softness she had never seen before. Her nose suddenly tingled.

"I always thought I would walk this road alone." Chen Ji's voice was very light, as if speaking to himself, "For survival, for revenge, I wrapped myself tightly, daring not to trust anyone. But..." he paused, a genuine smile appearing at the corner of his mouth, "You make me feel that perhaps I don't have to be so lonely."

text.content: Su Qingyao felt her eyes grow warm. She recalled the first time she met Chen Ji—back then, she only thought him a useless coward, someone who never fought back even when bullied. Later, she gradually realized something was wrong. This so-called "waste" carried too many secrets. And then, she found she could no longer look away.

dialogue.content: "Fool." She whispered softly, her voice trembling with a hint of emotion. "Who told you to carry everything alone? Did you think I was just decoration?" She reached out and gently grasped Chen Ji's hand. "From now on, your affairs are my affairs. No matter what blade or fire lies ahead, I, Su Qingyao, will walk this path with you."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a warm current surge in his chest—the emotions he had suppressed for too long finally found an outlet. He didn't speak, only turning his hand to grip Su Qingyao's. Their palms pressed together, temperatures mingling, as if at this moment, the entire world had become gentle. Morning light fell through the bamboo grove, stretching their two figures long and long.

After a long while, Chen Ji finally spoke softly: "Let's go, we need to make a plan." His voice had regained its usual calm, but Su Qingyao could sense that beneath that calm, something new had emerged—trust and dependence. And she welcomed it gladly.

choice.prompt: The imperial city infiltration plan requires careful deployment. How should Chen Ji arrange this operation?

choices.description: Act together with Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, using Ye Qing's demonic path mist to conceal the Tianji Record's aura
choices.visible_cost: Need to contact Ye Qing, exposing more information
choices.visible_reward: Demonic path mist can effectively conceal movements, improving infiltration success rate
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may have other motives

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then spoke: "I plan to contact Ye Qing." Su Qingyao's brow furrowed slightly: "The Holy Sect's Saint of the Demonic Path? Are you certain she's trustworthy?"
"Her demonic path mist can conceal the Tianji Record's aura—this is our greatest guarantee for infiltrating the imperial city." Chen Ji's gaze was sharp. "Moreover... we have a common enemy."

That night, Chen Ji met Ye Qing in a secluded mountain valley. The Demonic Path Saint, draped in black纱, appeared even more enigmatic under the moonlight. "Chen Ji, you've finally come to me willingly." A smile played at the corner of her lips. "Go on then, what do you need me to do?"
"The imperial city's forbidden grounds need your demonic path mist." Chen Ji got straight to the point. "In exchange, I will help you break free from the Holy Sect's control."

text.content: Ye Qing's eyes suddenly turned sharp. She stared at Chen Ji for a long moment, then burst into laughter: "Interesting! Chen Ji, you truly are interesting!" She extended her hand. "Deal!" Their palms struck together in the air, and a plan concerning the imperial city quietly took shape.

dialogue.content: 【System Prompt: Successfully reached cooperation agreement with Ye Qing, gained "Demonic Path Mist" skill buff—Tianji Record's aura will be completely concealed during imperial city infiltration!】

Su Qingyao watched Chen Ji negotiate with Ye Qing, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes. She didn't like the way Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji, but she understood even more clearly that this was not the time for such concerns. She stepped forward and stood at Chen Ji's side, silently declaring her position.

Ye Qing glanced at Su Qingyao, a teasing smile curling at her lips: "Senior Fellow Su Qingyao, your gaze is quite intimidating. What, afraid I'll steal your Chen Ji?" Su Qingyao said coldly: "I'm simply doing my duty." Ye Qing shrugged and said no more.

text.content: Chen Ji无奈地摇了摇头. These two women and their animosity—he wasn't blind to it. But this wasn't the time to deal with such matters. He cleared his throat and steered the conversation back on track: "Alright, here's the plan..."

The three gathered around a blue stone, and Chen Ji used a branch to sketch out the imperial city's general layout on the ground. "The forbidden grounds are in the northwestern corner of the imperial city, guarded by the imperial city royal guard. We need to enter in two groups—one to draw the guards' attention, one to infiltrate the forbidden grounds."

dialogue.content: "I'll draw the guards' attention." Su Qingyao volunteered. "My status as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow is enough to warrant their serious attention."
"You want me to infiltrate the forbidden grounds with Chen Ji?" Ye Qing raised an eyebrow. "You trust me that much? Aren't you afraid I'll stab you in the back?"
Chen Ji glanced at Ye Qing and said calmly: "Would you?" Ye Qing愣了一下, then laughed: "No. At least not now." She paused, adding, "That prophecy of mine about my fate—I haven't seen the answer yet."

text.content: The plan was finalized. Su Qingyao would handle drawing fire, Ye Qing would conceal their auras, and Chen Ji would infiltrate the forbidden grounds to find Chen Nian. Division of labor was clear, each fulfilling their role. Moonlight fell upon the three of them, stretching their shadows long. This night was destined to be an uneasy one.

dialogue.content: Before leaving, Su Qingyao suddenly grabbed Chen Ji's sleeve. "Chen Ji, promise me one thing." Her voice was soft yet exceptionally earnest. "Come back alive." Chen Ji looked at her serious expression and suddenly reached out to ruffle her hair: "Don't worry. I still owe you an answer."

Ye Qing watched this scene from the side, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of her lips. She didn't speak, simply turning to leave, leaving behind a lightly drifting phrase: "Three days later, at the Imperial City."

Watching Ye Qing's departing silhouette, Su Qingyao softly said: "She... seems to treat you differently." Chen Ji shook his head with a bitter smile: "She's merely interested in the Tianji Record's prophecy." Su Qingyao said nothing more, only tightly gripping Chen Ji's hand.

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze to Su Qingyao's clasped hand, a warm current surging in his heart. He suddenly recalled a phrase—the world may be cruel, but there are always those willing to walk beside you. He drew a deep breath, treasuring this warmth in the deepest corner of his heart. "Let's go," he said, "rest well tonight. Starting tomorrow, we fight with everything we have."

choices.description: Only act with Su Qingyao, without relying on Ye Qing's power, maintaining the plan's secrecy
choices.visible_cost: Lacking the cover of Demonic Path mist, higher risk
choices.visible_reward: Plan remains more covert, not dependent on outsiders
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Record's aura may expose their whereabouts

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head: "No need to contact Ye Qing. Those from the Demonic Path cannot be fully trusted." A glint of relief flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes as she nodded: "Then how do we infiltrate?"

After a moment of contemplation, Chen Ji drew a talisman from his chest. "This is an invisibility talisman I acquired by chance. It can only last one hour. But as long as we're fast enough, it will suffice."

text.content: Su Qingyao took the talisman, sensing the spiritual energy contained within. She didn't ask where the talisman came from, only nodding: "Alright, I trust you." The two exchanged a smile, everything understood without words.

In the following time, Chen Ji and Su Qingyao began detailed planning of the infiltration route. Chen Ji used the Tianji Record Fragment to repeatedly deduce, marking every possible variable. Relying on her understanding of the Imperial City's forbidden formations, Su Qingyao drew a detailed defense map.

dialogue.content: "The Forbidden Grounds' guard shift change is at midnight and noon," Su Qingyao pointed at the defense map. "We can use this window to infiltrate. But there are also restriction formations inside..."
"I know." Chen Ji interrupted her. "The Tianji Record can sense the weak points of formations. As long as you buy me a quarter of an hour, I can find the breaking method."

Su Qingyao looked at him, then softly sighed: "Chen Ji, you're always like this. Carrying everything yourself, never willing to say a word." Her voice carried a hint of heartache. "Can't you try relying on me a little?"
Chen Ji froze for a moment, then showed a bitter smile: "Habit." He paused, his voice softening slightly. "But... I'll try to change."

text.content: Su Qingyao's eyes slightly reddened. She reached out, gently grasping Chen Ji's hand. Their fingers intertwined, appearing exceptionally warm under the moonlight.

After the plan was finalized, the two began to rest. But Chen Ji knew he couldn't sleep—the Tianji Record's trembling still echoed in his mind, Chen Nian's figure lingering persistently. He closed his eyes, silently deducing every possible variable in his heart.

dialogue.content: After an unknown period, a warm hand gently covered his eyes. "Stop thinking." Su Qingyao's voice rang in his ear. "You've already done very well. Rest a bit, there's still a tough battle tomorrow."

Chen Ji said nothing, simply letting that warm palm rest over his eyes. In the darkness, he could feel Su Qingyao's breathing, could smell her faint fragrance. At this moment, those cold calculations and wariness in his heart seemed to melt away a few degrees.

text.content: "Three days later," he softly said. "In three days, everything will end." Su Qingyao didn't answer, only gripping his hand even tighter. Outside the window, the moon gradually sank westward, a new day about to arrive.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, morning light had already filtered through the bamboo leaves onto the ground. Su Qingyao had left at some point, leaving only a robe draped over him, still carrying her unique fragrance. Chen Ji folded the robe neatly, a faint smile appearing at the corner of his lips.

Just then, hurried footsteps shattered the morning's tranquility. Chen Ji's expression sharpened, he rose abruptly. The footsteps drew closer, carrying a violent aura, as if some killing deity was approaching. The next moment, the bamboo grove's curtain was violently thrown open, and a tall figure appeared before him—it was Han Lie!

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Han Lie was drenched in blood, blazing fury burning in his eyes. "You're here! Excellent! I was just looking for you!" His voice was hoarse, yet carried an undeniable killing intent. "The Xuanwu Sect will launch a full-scale attack on the Tianqing Sect in three days—did you hear this news?"

text.content: Chen Ji looked at this blood-soaked figure, his mind rapidly calculating. How did Han Lie get injured? Isn't he the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius? Who could have wounded him? Countless questions flooded his mind, but his expression remained calm as still water. "I've heard," he said coolly. "Sect Master Ling has already informed me."

dialogue.content: "Ling Yuan?" Han Lie sneered, "That old fox sure has well-informed sources." He stared at Chen Ji, his fury burning even brighter, "But I didn't come here to discuss that—Chen Ji, do you know who proposed this coordinated attack?"

text.content: "Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, an ominous premonition washing over his heart. Han Lie spoke the name word by word: 'It's the Supreme Elder of Xuanwu Sect—Han Wuji. He is... my grandfather.' Chen Ji's heart sank sharply. Han Wuji, that legendary Transformation God stage expert, the pillar of Xuanwu Sect. Why would he personally initiate this coordinated attack?"

dialogue.content: "He's not doing this merely for sect disputes." Han Lie's voice dropped low, "He's searching for something—the Tianji Record!" Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Han Wuji knew about the Tianji Record's existence? What did this mean? Could it be... he had been under surveillance all along?"

text.content: "Han Lie watched Chen Ji's expression shift dramatically, then burst into wild laughter: 'What, scared?' His laughter carried a hint of madness, 'Chen Ji啊 Chen Ji, did you think you were hiding it well? Did you think your little cleverness could fool everyone?' He abruptly stopped smiling, his eyes brimming with killing intent, 'My grandfather knew the Tianji Record was in your possession long ago. This coordinated attack is merely to force you out!"

"Chen Ji's heart sank to the bottom of the abyss, but his expression remained as calm as still water. He looked at Han Lie, his voice low: 'You came to me just to say this?' Han Lie sneered: 'I came to kill you!' His aura surged violently, wild spiritual energy erupting like a storm, 'You stole everything that should have been mine! I'll make you pay the price!'"

"Chen Ji looked at this raving man before him, yet his heart was extraordinarily calm. Han Lie, despite his overwhelming combat power, had a simple mind and was easily manipulated. He said Han Wuji came for the Tianji Record—was this true, or was someone pulling strings behind the scenes? In any case, now was not the time to reveal his trump cards."

dialogue.content: "Han Lie." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice unusually calm, "Does your grandfather know the Tianji Record is on you?" Han Lie's movements abruptly halted, the fury in his eyes instantly replaced by confusion."
"What do you mean?" Han Lie's voice trembled slightly, clearly moved by Chen Ji's words."

"Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward, revealing a profound smile: 'If he already knew the Tianji Record was on you, why orchestrate this coordinated attack? Wouldn't simply demanding it from you be simpler?' He paused, 'Unless... he has no idea exactly who has the Tianji Record. And you are merely his chess piece.'"

text.content: "Han Lie's complexion turned ashen. He stared fixedly at Chen Ji, his chest heaving violently, clearly struggling to suppress the upheaval within. Chen Ji's words were like a venomous barb, lodged deeply in his heart. He had always believed himself to be the most brilliant talent of Xuanwu Sect, his grandfather's most valued descendant. But now..."

dialogue.content: "You're lying!" Han Lie roared, "Grandfather placed great hopes in me! He personally said he would pass on all his lifetime's knowledge to me!" But his voice had already lost its previous conviction."

text.content: "Chen Ji watched Han Lie's wavering expression, a cold smile forming in his heart. This man, despite his overwhelming combat power, was far too easily manipulated. He never trusted anyone, nor did he believe in so-called 'family affection.' In his view, Han Wuji's kindness toward Han Lie was merely to exploit his talent. But these words, he would not speak—some seeds merely needed to be planted."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji said nothing more. He simply stood there quietly, his gaze calm as he watched Han Lie. The wind in the bamboo grove blew gently, lifting a few bamboo leaves that spun in the air. After a long while, Han Lie suddenly dismissed his overwhelming aura and turned to leave."

"'In three days, the coordinated attack will proceed as scheduled.' Han Lie's voice came from his retreating back, carrying a complex emotion, 'At that time... I will come find you personally.' With that, his figure vanished into the depths of the bamboo grove."

text.content: "Chen Ji watched Han Lie's departing figure, a profound light flickering in his eyes. In three days, Xuanwu Sect's coordinated attack; in the imperial forbidden grounds, his sister Chen Nian was trapped; Han Wuji entered the field personally for the Tianji Record; Ling Yuan's intentions remained unclear... all the pieces were moving, and what he needed to do was to take the most crucial step in this grand chess game."

"Chen Ji took a deep breath, turned, and walked toward the depths of the bamboo pavilion. There, Su Qingyao was waiting for him. He knew there was no turning back from the journey to the imperial capital. No matter how many difficulties and obstacles lay ahead, he had to press forward—for the secrets of the Tianji Record, for his sister Chen Nian, and for those companions willing to stand beside him. At this moment, his heart was unshakably resolute."
